description: This PHP class 'I18NHelper' provides internationalization support by wrapping around an 'I18NService'. It offers methods to translate keys or source strings based on configuration settings and to set the translator language.

classes.name: I18NHelper
classes.description: A helper class for internationalization that simplifies translation and language setting operations, relying on an underlying I18NService.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a key into the current language, returning the key itself if internationalization is disabled.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source language string into the current language, returning the source string if internationalization is disabled.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for the I18NService translator.
